concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-001 (ingest flux‑calibrated HST FITS images and extract required metadata) is not covered by any task. The tasks list only acquires real images (T009) but never implements a loader or validation step for those images, leaving the requirement unimplemented.

Functional Requirement FR-009 (verify that input dataset contains calibrated images *and* metadata fields such as exposure time, filter, pixel scale) is only partially addressed by the missing‑WCS test (T010). No task checks the additional metadata fields, so the requirement remains unmet.

Constitution Principle VII mandates cross‑checking derived calibration functions against an independent, manually vetted validation dataset. The current tasks validate calibration only on a held‑out synthetic subset (T028, T045) and never reference the real HST validation set acquired in T009, violating the constitution.
